from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserCreatedData:
    count: int
    ratio: float
    opt_count: int | None = None
    opt_ratio: float | None = None
    ints: list[int] | None = None
    nums: list[float] | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserCreatedData:
        return cls(
            count=data.get("count"),
            ratio=data.get("ratio"),
            opt_count=data.get("optCount"),
            opt_ratio=data.get("optRatio"),
            ints=data.get("ints"),
            nums=data.get("nums"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "count": self.count,
            "ratio": self.ratio,
            "optCount": self.opt_count,
            "optRatio": self.opt_ratio,
            "ints": self.ints,
            "nums": self.nums,
        }
